title: Frames and a Table for an Arm in Three Dimensions: Poses, the Two Denavit-Hartenberg Conventions, and Two Real Arms Written Down

artifact.note: poses in three dimensions as a rotation matrix and a translation (compose, inverse, a transformed point, re-orthonormalising a rotation that has drifted), the Denavit-Hartenberg row in both conventions (standard: Rz(theta) Tz(d) Tx(a) Rx(alpha); modified: Rx(alpha) Tx(a) Rz(theta) Tz(d)), an arm table with joint offsets and limits, and two real arms written as tables with their sources: the UR5 (standard) and the Franka Emika Panda (modified)
